infotexts.entitydescription.mandrakeextract: Removes the effect of ‖color:gui.yellow‖Growth Elixirs‖end‖ from body.\n\n"I've added flavours for easier consumption! can't you see how much i care of my beloved test subj-... I mean volunteers!?"
infotexts.entitydescription.growthelixirb: Add the effect of ‖color:#00FFFF‖Growth Elixirs Type B‖end‖ to body, effect is effective when wearing appropriate outfit.\n\nThe potion is mildly potent, It is adored by many of Saya's non-rat testers and they can't get enough of it!
infotexts.entitydescription.growthelixirc: Add the effect of ‖color:#E300FF‖Growth Elixirs Type C‖end‖ to body, effect is effective when wearing appropriate outfit.\n\nThis potion is super potent, Saya said it is the pinnacle of alchemy.
